_schema.purpose: Pin Ed25519 signing of canonical JSON over (eventMeta || eventBody). Auth is NEVER part of signed bytes.

format.vectors[].name: Human label.
format.vectors[].signingKey.private: base64url-no-pad of the 32-byte Ed25519 seed (NOT expanded secret key).
format.vectors[].signingKey.public: base64url-no-pad of the 32-byte Ed25519 public key derived from `private`.
format.vectors[].event.meta: Object: { v, eventId?, roomId, authorId, deviceId, createdAt:int-ms, parentEventIds:[sorted], snapshotId? (omit if absent) }.
format.vectors[].event.body: Object: ReviewEventBody. Shape is event-kind-specific; treat as opaque JSON for signing.
format.vectors[].expected.canonicalSignedBytes: UTF-8 string: canonicalJSON({meta, body}). Useful to debug divergence before the signature step.

vectors.name: minimal comment event with no parents and no snapshot
